annotations.title: Get Campaign Delivery Metrics & Scheduled Queue

description: Retrieve historical push campaign delivery metrics (delivered count, click count, CTR percentage, credits spent) and active scheduled queue items (cmp_sch_xxxx). Use this tool to audit campaign performance or look up scheduled campaign IDs before editing or canceling them with schedule_push_notification; do not use it to inspect QRIS payment invoices (use check_billing_and_qris_status instead) or subscriber device lists (use list_subscribers instead). Read-only operation requiring PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY with 0 credit cost; omitting app_id aggregates metrics across all workspace apps up to limit rows. Returns JSON { summary: { total_sent, total_clicks, avg_ctr_percent }, campaigns: [{ id, app_id, title, delivered_count, click_count, ctr_percent, created_at }], scheduled_queue: [{ id, app_id, title, scheduled_for, recurrence_rule, status }] }.

app_id.description: Optional application ID filter in format app_xxxx (omit to aggregate across all workspace apps)

limit.description: Maximum number of recent campaigns to return (1 to 50, default: 10)

name: get_campaign_analytics
